quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. on his childhood admiration for Derrick Rose
quotes.excerpt: For me growing up, Derrick Rose for sure.
quotes.quote: For me growing up, Derrick Rose for sure. It's funny because I used to tell people when I went to school elementary that he was my cousin. Everybody used to call me on it so much, like people I knew. I played like him, so the people I didn't really know, I was like, 'That's my cousin, Derrick Rose, that's my cousin.' I'm lying though. Actually, when we landed in Sacramento, that was the first time he called me. I was telling Coach Cal, I almost cried. It was crazy.
